sources.relevant_scope: Accepts original research and methods/software submissions, including negative results; requires technically sound methods, supported conclusions, research integrity, and data-availability standards.
Any manuscript length; LaTeX submitted as PDF; single-column double-spaced text; continuous page and line numbers; Vancouver references.

Public availability is the default. Legal/ethical and third-party restrictions have specific disclosure and access-contact requirements; author-only access contact is not acceptable. Policy identifies inaccessible proprietary-data conditions that PLOS will not consider.
PLOS supplies a LaTeX template and BibTeX style; Vancouver reference style is used. Owner-review PDF is not a final submission template package.
Official figure guidance checked 2026-11-06: separate files, RGB 8-bit or grayscale, 300–600 dpi, no alpha channel, LZW-compressed TIFF, file size under 10 MB, and excess whitespace cropped.
